items.name: ivory voluminous-sleeve blouse
items.visual_description: pale ivory blouse with voluminous sleeves, V neckline, front button closure, shaped waist, and peplum hem
items.wearing_logic: worn as the visible top; hem sits over the upper skirt waist rather than being fully tucked away

items.name: brown long straight skirt with front slit
items.visual_description: warm brown high-waisted long skirt, straight column silhouette, below-knee to ankle length, front slit, back seam and welt pockets
items.wearing_logic: starts underneath the blouse hem and replaces the blue jeans completely

items.name: brown leather belt with metal buckle
items.visual_description: medium brown leather belt with a rounded metal buckle, strap holes, loops, and panel-like side details
items.wearing_logic: worn at the waist; can be partly visible where the blouse hem allows, but must not become the dominant waist detail

items.name: dark green wedge sandals
items.visual_description: dark green glossy wedge sandals with ankle straps, buckle closure, open toe, and crocodile-like texture
items.wearing_logic: replace the gray socks with bare feet wearing these sandals

items.name: large gold disc earrings
items.visual_description: large gold circular statement earrings with ridged spiral disc texture and dark top element
items.wearing_logic: add as visible earrings if the ears are visible; do not change the person's face

outfit_logic: Replace the gray sweater, blue jeans, and gray socks completely.
The ivory blouse is the visible top.
The blouse hem remains visible over the upper skirt.
The brown skirt starts underneath the blouse hem.
The brown belt is secondary and can be partially visible at the waist.
The dark green wedge sandals replace socks and any current footwear.
The gold earrings are added only without changing the face.
negative_constraints: do not leave the gray sweater visible
do not leave blue jeans visible
do not leave gray socks visible
do not turn the outfit into a dress
do not copy the faces or bodies of reference models
do not change the person's identity
do not change the room background
do not simplify the blouse sleeves, skirt slit, shoe straps, or earring texture
